0.title: Same quad and T-spin start, one extra quad for Cold Clear
0.summary: pinglamb places the held S first, then both sides make the same I quad down column 7 and a T-spin single, reaching 7 attack each. After that pinglamb gets 5 more from a 2-line I clear and a T-spin double. Cold Clear gets 7 more from two 2-line J clears and a second quad down column 9, so it finishes 14 to 12.

claims.text: pinglamb takes the I from hold and drops it into column 7 at rows 8-11: a quad for 4 attack.
Cold Clear places its first piece in the same column 7 slot, making the same quad for 4 attack.
After step 5, both boards take pinglamb's 2 incoming garbage rows, with the hole in column 3.
pinglamb's T from hold makes a T-spin double for 4 attack, landing in the column 7 gap on row 10.
Cold Clear's I from hold goes into column 9 at rows 6-9 and makes a second quad, worth 5 attack.
Final totals: pinglamb 12 attack, Cold Clear 14.

1.title: T-spins against two quads
1.summary: Both sides place the J and then make the same T-spin double for 5 attack. pinglamb adds a second T-spin double for 6 at step 8, but the 2-line L clear on the next step ends the back-to-back. Cold Clear clears 3 lines with an L, then makes quads at steps 9 and 14, so it finishes 17 to 12.

claims.text: On both sides the T fills rows 10-11 at columns 4-6: a T-spin double for 5 attack.
pinglamb's T from hold makes a second T-spin double, worth 6 attack with back-to-back at 3.
pinglamb's L from hold clears 2 lines for 1 attack, and the back-to-back drops back to none.
Cold Clear's I from hold goes into column 9 at rows 6-9 and makes a quad for 5 attack.
Cold Clear's I fills column 10 at rows 1-4 and makes a second quad for 5 attack, leaving 1 garbage row.
pinglamb places the I upright in column 10 at rows 13-16, and the stack ends 16 rows high.

2.title: A combo against a garbage climb
2.summary: Cold Clear clears lines on six pieces in a row, steps 2 to 7, for 14 lines. Its combo runs up to 5, and the last two clears of that run are quads worth 8 and 11. pinglamb's clears add up to only 3 attack. Both sides take the same 5 garbage rows from the bottom: pinglamb after step 2, Cold Clear after step 8. pinglamb ends with a stack 19 rows high, while Cold Clear's ends at row 6, finishing 32 to 3.

claims.text: pinglamb takes the I from hold and places it in column 10. It clears 2 lines for 1 attack, and the back-to-back drops to none.
After pinglamb's O, 5 garbage rows come in with the hole in column 1.
Cold Clear's I from hold goes into column 7 at rows 6-9: a quad on combo 4, worth 8 attack.
The next I goes into column 9 at rows 1-4: a second quad, now on combo 5, worth 11 attack.
Step 8 is Cold Clear's first piece since step 1 that clears no line, and pinglamb's 5 garbage rows go in after it.
Cold Clear's I goes into the column 1 garbage hole at rows 1-4: a quad for 6 attack. That brings its total to 32, against pinglamb's 3.

3.title: A spin and a quad
3.summary: Cold Clear opened with a T-spin double for 4 attack and later cleared a quad for 5, finishing the 14 pieces at 11 attack to pinglamb's 5. pinglamb's largest single send was a 2-attack T-spin single at step 8. Over the same stretch pinglamb took 8 garbage rows: 3 at step 11 and 5 at step 13.

claims.text: The T goes into columns 9-10, rows 5-7. It clears 1 line with no spin and sends 0 attack.
Cold Clear's T lands in columns 8-10, rows 5-6, for a T-spin double worth 4 attack.
pinglamb plays the T from hold for a T-spin single that clears 1 line and sends 2 attack, the largest send pinglamb makes in this clip.
A vertical I in column 9, rows 5-8, clears 4 lines. The quad sends 5 attack.
The L clears no lines, and 3 garbage rows are inserted at the bottom after this lock.
The J clears no lines and 5 more garbage rows come in. The clip ends with pinglamb on 5 attack and Cold Clear on 11.

4.title: Same column, double versus quad
4.summary: pinglamb and Cold Clear both drop a vertical I into the same four cells of column 3. For pinglamb at step 2 it clears 2 lines; for Cold Clear at step 6, after the stack has been built up, it clears a quad. Cold Clear adds a second quad and a triple to finish on 12 attack against pinglamb's 1, and pinglamb takes 5 garbage rows.

claims.text: A vertical I in column 3, rows 7-10, clears 2 lines for 1 attack. It is pinglamb's only attack in the clip.
Cold Clear plays the I from hold into the same column-3 cells, rows 7-10. It clears 4 lines and the quad sends 5 attack.
The Z clears no lines, and 4 garbage rows are inserted at the bottom after this lock.
A second vertical I, this one in column 7 at rows 8-11, clears another quad for 5 attack.
The L from hold clears 3 lines for 2 attack, bringing Cold Clear's total to 12.
The J from hold clears no lines and 1 more garbage row comes in, making 5 rows received in the clip.

5.title: Matching T-spins, then quads
5.summary: Both sides make a T-spin double at step 5, worth 5 attack for pinglamb and 4 for Cold Clear. pinglamb's I at step 7 clears only 2 lines, and Cold Clear's I at step 7 clears a quad. Cold Clear's second quad at step 11 outscores pinglamb's quad on the same step (5 attack against 4), for a final total of 15 to 10.

claims.text: The T fills columns 4-6 at rows 13-14 for a T-spin double worth 5 attack.
Cold Clear's T-spin double on the same step sends 4 attack.
A vertical I in column 5, rows 11-14, clears 2 lines for 1 attack.
Cold Clear's vertical I in column 4, rows 7-10, clears 4 lines. The quad sends 5 attack.
pinglamb's vertical I takes column 4, rows 7-10, clearing 4 lines for a quad worth 4 attack.
Cold Clear's vertical I in column 5, rows 1-4, clears its second quad for 5 attack. Final totals: Cold Clear 15, pinglamb 10.

6.title: Two quads through the garbage
6.summary: Starting from the same stack, both sides lose their back-to-back early: pinglamb with a J triple at step 5, Cold Clear with an O double at step 4. From there Cold Clear clears 2, 3 and then 4 lines on consecutive pieces, finishing with a vertical I quad down the column-6 garbage well for 6 attack. It adds a second quad down column 3 at step 14. pinglamb clears 3, 2, 1 and 1 lines for 3 attack in total and ends with the four column-6 garbage rows still on the board.

claims.text: pinglamb's J goes into columns 9-10 at rows 14-16 and clears 3 lines for 2 attack. The back-to-back counter drops from 2 to -1.
Cold Clear's O from hold goes into columns 9-10 at rows 15-16 and clears 2 lines for 1 attack, starting a combo.
Cold Clear's I from hold drops vertically into column 6 at rows 9-12 and clears 4 garbage rows: a quad worth 6 attack at combo 2.
Cold Clear's I goes vertically into column 3 at rows 6-9 and clears 4 garbage rows: a quad worth 5 attack, with back-to-back now at 1.
pinglamb's last I stands vertically in column 7 at rows 16-19 and clears 1 line for 0 attack. Four garbage rows with a hole in column 6 (rows 12-15) are still on the board.
Totals over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 3 attack, Cold Clear 14.

7.title: Same cells, triple versus quad
7.summary: pinglamb and Cold Clear drop an I into the same cells: column 10, rows 3-6. pinglamb does it at step 2, while row 6 still has gaps, and gets a triple. Cold Clear first fills row 6 and does it at step 5 for a quad. Cold Clear then digs down column 5 with a second quad at step 9. pinglamb's T-spin single at step 8 starts a back-to-back that the very next clear ends, and pinglamb finishes with five garbage rows still open in column 5. Totals are 6 for pinglamb and 9 for Cold Clear.

claims.text: pinglamb's I from hold goes vertically into column 10 at rows 3-6 and clears 3 lines for 2 attack. Row 6 has gaps and stays.
Cold Clear's I goes into the same cells, column 10 at rows 3-6. Row 6 is already filled in columns 1-9, so the I completes all four rows: a quad worth 4 attack.
pinglamb's T from hold lands in columns 3-4 at rows 8-10 and clears 1 line as a T-spin single for 2 attack, setting back-to-back to 0.
pinglamb's next clear is an O double in columns 5-6 (1 attack, combo 1). It resets back-to-back to -1.
Cold Clear's I goes vertically into column 5 at rows 1-4 and clears 4 garbage rows: a quad worth 4 attack.

Totals over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 6 attack, Cold Clear 9. pinglamb's final board still holds six garbage rows (five with a hole in column 5 at rows 2-6, one with a hole in column 3 at row 1), while Cold Clear's holds two.

8.title: Same T-spin, then two paths
8.summary: Both sides place the T in the same cells at step 3 for a T-spin double worth 4 attack. After that, pinglamb clears five single lines for 0 attack. Cold Clear sends an I quad down column 4 (5 attack), then a second T-spin double on back-to-back (5 attack), then an S double (1 attack). Totals are 4 for pinglamb and 15 for Cold Clear.

claims.text: Both sides place the T in the same cells, columns 7-9 at row 14 and column 8 at row 13. Each clears 2 lines as a T-spin double for 4 attack.
pinglamb's J at step 13 clears 1 line for 0 attack. It is the fifth single after step 3, following steps 4, 7, 9 and 11, and none of the five sends attack.
Cold Clear's I goes vertically into column 4 at rows 7-10 and clears 4 garbage rows: a quad worth 5 attack at combo 1.
Cold Clear's T lands in columns 3-5 at row 9 and column 4 at row 8. It clears 2 lines as a T-spin double for 5 attack, with back-to-back at 1.
pinglamb's L from hold goes to columns 7-9 at rows 13-14 and clears nothing. 5 garbage rows are inserted after it.
Totals over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 4 attack, Cold Clear 15. Cold Clear's step-14 S cleared 2 lines, so its matching 5 garbage rows are not yet on its board when the clip ends.

9.title: Cold Clear quads first, pinglamb takes the garbage first
9.summary: Both sides start with 6 garbage rows incoming. pinglamb places a J from hold and takes all 6 rows at once; Cold Clear clears a quad in column 7 on its first piece, so the rows wait until its next 0-line lock. Both then score a T-spin double and both lose back-to-back to a later non-spin clear: pinglamb finishes on a combo of singles, Cold Clear on a triple and two doubles, and the totals end 13 to 15.

claims.text: Cold Clear drops an I into column 7 and clears a quad, rows 5-8, for 6 attack.
pinglamb places a J from hold and clears nothing, so all 6 garbage rows are inserted at the bottom after this step.
T-spin double at rows 17-18 sends 4 attack and starts back-to-back.
An I from hold clears a quad in column 7, rows 11-14, for 6 attack with back-to-back 1 and combo 1.
A Z single makes it five line-clearing pieces in a row (steps 9-13, starting with a T-spin mini single), reaching combo 4; steps 11-13 send 1 attack each.
Total attack over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 13, Cold Clear 15.

10.title: Same T-spin, different follow-up
10.summary: pinglamb and Cold Clear place the first two pieces identically, ending in a T-spin double for 5 attack at back-to-back 2. pinglamb's next piece, a Z, clears two lines without a spin and resets back-to-back, while Cold Clear builds without clearing for four pieces and then lands a T-spin triple worth 8. pinglamb's later T-spin double sends 4 more, and the totals end 10 to 13.

claims.text: Both sides place a T from hold into the same slot, a T-spin double worth 5 attack, and back-to-back reaches 2.
pinglamb's Z clears 2 lines with no spin for 1 attack, and back-to-back drops to -1.
Cold Clear's T-spin triple clears rows 5-7 for 8 attack, its largest of the clip, and back-to-back rises to 3.
A T from hold makes a T-spin double for 4 attack and starts a new back-to-back at 0.
Cold Clear's last piece, a J, clears a single for 0 attack and ends its back-to-back.
Total attack over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 10, Cold Clear 13.

11.title: Column 10: double versus quad
11.summary: The first three pieces are identical on both sides and end in an L double for 1 attack. On step 4 pinglamb puts the held I into column 10 and clears a double, while Cold Clear lays the I flat and keeps column 10 open until a quad on step 9. Both sides take 4 garbage rows over the clip, and the totals end 3 to 6.

claims.text: Both sides place the same L and clear 2 lines for 1 attack.
pinglamb puts the held I upright in column 10, rows 6-9, and clears a double for 1 attack at combo 1.
Cold Clear lays the held I flat across columns 5-8 on row 8 and clears nothing.
An I in column 10 clears a quad, rows 8-11, for 4 attack.
A J in columns 7-8 clears 2 lines for 1 attack, pinglamb's last attack of the clip.
Total attack over the 14 pieces: pinglamb 3, Cold Clear 6; each side received 4 garbage rows.
